results.Summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Forester and Sunseeker motorhomes.  The park brake signal wire may not be connected to the house battery control center, which can allow the slideroom to extend during transit.
results.Consequence: A slideroom unexpectedly extends increases the risk of a crash.
results.Remedy: Dealers will connect the signal wire to the battery control center, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 12, 2023.  Owners may contact Forest River Customer Service at 1-574-206-7600.  Forest River's number for this recall is 34-1707.
results.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

results.Summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Solera, 2023-2025 Forester, and Sunseeker motorhomes.  The Liquid Propane (LP) line may not be properly secured, which can cause the line to become damaged and leak.
results.Consequence: A propane gas leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.
results.Remedy: Dealers will install a p-clamp to secure the LP line, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 28, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River Customer Service at 1-574-206-7600.  Forest River's number for this recall is 34-1780.
results.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.
